Load release length data from a creel connection

Source: R/fetch-loaders.R
fetch_release_lengths.Rd

Reads the release lengths table from a creel data source, renames columns to canonical tidycreel names, coerces types, validates, and returns a data frame ready for tidycreel::add_lengths().

Usage

fetch_release_lengths(conn, ...)

Arguments

conn

A creel_connection object created by creel_connect().

...

Reserved for future arguments.

Value

A data frame with canonical columns: length_uid, interview_uid, species (character), length_type (character), and a length: length_mm (numeric) for measured fish, or length_bin (character) with count (numeric) for binned rows. At least one of the two must be mapped; the binned pair is carried only when the source names it (GH #127). Extra CSV columns are dropped.
